passages.text: Echeveria purpusiorum is a species of flowering plant in the family Crassulaceae, endemic to Puebla and Oaxaca, Mexico.

Description 
Echeveria purpusiorum have pointy, oval, and thick leaves with about {{convert|1.6|in|mm}} long and {{convert|1|in|mm}} wide. The leaves color is deep olive-green, grey-green, or white-green, with red-brown markings. The rosette slowly grows up to {{convert|3.2|in|mm}} tall and {{convert|3.2|in|mm}} in diameter. The flowers color is scarlet red, with yellow tips and bloom in late-spring with {{convert|12|in|mm}} long stem.
